description: Source code for handling embedded bitmaps in TrueType and OpenType fonts within the FreeType project, including functions for loading, parsing, and rendering embedded bitmaps and PNG images.

methods.name: tt_face_load_sbit
methods.description: Loads embedded bitmap data for a font face, identifying the table type and extracting strike information.

methods.name: tt_face_free_sbit
methods.description: Frees resources associated with embedded bitmap data.

methods.name: tt_face_set_sbit_strike
methods.description: Selects a specific strike (size) for embedded bitmaps based on requested size.

methods.name: tt_face_load_strike_metrics
methods.description: Loads metrics for a specific strike, including size and bearing information.

methods.name: tt_face_load_sbit_image
methods.description: Loads a specific embedded bitmap image for a glyph, handling different table types and image formats.
